Great — thanks for the clarity, Claire. Answers inline and a quick pricing sketch below. Marissa / Dev copied to scope infra sizing and licensing approach.

Q1) Pricing models we typically offer for Private/VPC:
- Annual enterprise license (platform fee) + per-token serving charge: good for predictable procurement and includes basic support.
- Reserved capacity (monthly/annual commit): you reserve GPU pools (throughput guarantees) and pay lower per-token rates.
- Hybrid: enterprise license + reserved pools for prod + burst-to-shared for peaks.

Example unit economics (illustrative; final quote will depend on model/quantization/avgerage seq len):
- Hybrid (recommended for you):
  - Enterprise license: $180,000 / year (includes 2 environments and standard business-hour support).
  - Reserved capacity + serving: $850 per 1M tokens (for high-efficiency configs / quantized models).
  - Burst/shared capacity for peaks: $1,400 per 1M tokens (pay-as-you-go when above reserved).
- Fully reserved (no burst): $220,000 / year + $700 per 1M tokens (lower serving rate but higher fixed commit).

Support tiers (annual add-on):
- Standard (included): business-hours support + quarterly reviews.
- Premium: +20% of license (24/7 on-call, 1-hour P1 SLA, dedicated SE).

Environment pricing:
- Base license includes up to 2 environments in a single region (prod + staging).
- Additional environment in-region: $5,000 / month.
- Additional region / DR: one-time region enable fee $15,000 + $5k/mo for environment capacity.

Given your ~180M steady-state and 320M peak, a reasonable configuration to cost-justify and keep latency predictable would be:
- Hybrid: enterprise license ($180k/yr) + reserved pool sized for 220–250M tokens/month + burst for month-end peaks. Estimated blended $/1M tokens ~ $800–$950 depending on how much you reserve.

I attached a short XLS that shows a few modeled scenarios (steady vs reserved vs fully reserved). If that looks reasonable we'll produce a formal SOW and pricing spreadsheet to send to procurement.

Attachment: license_summary.xlsx (pricing scenarios)

Next steps proposal:
- Confirm preferred model (Hybrid vs Fully reserved) — reply to this thread.
- Schedule 30m with Marissa (SE) to pin environment sizing (Wed/Thu next week works for us).
- If okay, we'll prepare a formal quote + SOW for procurement.
